_about: Objective BACKING measurement for the WS2 architectural-grammar GAP review (2026-06-15). NOT a pixel-similarity instrument — the frames are different camera framings (see report method caveat). These are STRUCTURE-DISTRIBUTION proxies that BACK the manual PRESENCE/COHERENCE rubric (Discipline #4 — manual architectural-grammar read is the gate; these numbers corroborate, they do not score). Generated by pipeline/arch-grammar-band-probe.mjs.
_thr: Sobel gradient-magnitude edge threshold = 40 (separates built-structure edges from texture noise). upper band = top third of frame (where an iso-ARPG raised gallery storey reads); lower band = bottom two-thirds (fighting floor). arcade-rhythm = count of periodic peaks in the upper-band per-column edge profile (120-bin) via autocorrelation > 0.2 — a regular colonnade/arcade/balustrade produces periodic side-lobes; scattered verticals do not.

reference_summary.arcadeRhythm_periodicPeaks_range: 0-4 (mean ~1.6; 5 of 8 frames >=1; the cathedral/timber/graveyard frames show 2-4 — a measurable built rhythm)
reference_summary.note: storeyRatio is NOT a clean discriminator (ref spans 0.60-1.24) because the reference also carries dense lower-floor dressing; this is exactly why the review is a manual PRESENCE/COHERENCE read, not an edge-density read.

our_iter3_summary.arcadeRhythm_periodicPeaks_range: 0-1 (5 of 6 frames = 0; only zone2 = 1). NO built rhythm — consistent with scattered verticals / no arcade / no balustrade.
our_iter3_summary.interpretation: edge densities are HIGH (often above reference) because our dense floor+perimeter dressing clutter generates edges — but the clutter is NOT organized into a periodic built rhythm. The probe corroborates: we have BUSYNESS, not BUILT-COHERENCE. The absence of periodic peaks across the corpus is the objective backing for the (a) load-path and (b) arcade gap reads.

our_iter4_descent._note: Re-run 2026-06-15 for the iter4 architectural-grammar RE-SCORE (AFTER Drax's WS2 second wave: pier->arch arcade, windows-in-wall, gallery storey + balustrade, full floor tile, rubble-only free verticals). Same probe, same threshold (40), same 6 matched set positions as iter3 (establish_01 + zone0/1/2/4/5) PLUS the 3 iter3 did not run (establish_02/03, zone3).

our_iter4_summary.arcadeRhythm_periodicPeaks_range_matched: 0-1 (4 of 6 = 0; zone1 AND zone2 = 1). iter3 was 0-1 (5/6 = 0; only zone2 = 1). The probe moved from one frame-at-peak-1 to two frames-at-peak-1 — but the MAXIMUM is still 1; it did NOT reach the reference's 2-4 band.
our_iter4_summary.probe_verdict_CAVEAT_GOVERNS: The probe did NOT discriminate the iter4 build the way it discriminated the iter3 gap, and this is a known limitation of the instrument for THIS framing — NOT evidence the arcade is absent. The probe measures vertical-edge periodicity in the UPPER THIRD of the frame as clean vertical columns; iter4's arcade/balustrade/gallery rhythm runs DIAGONALLY and FORESHORTENED across near-overhead per-zone framings (the camera looks DOWN INTO the chambers, not side-on along a colonnade), so a real periodic rhythm lands in the lower-two-thirds at an angle the upper-band column-autocorrelation cannot see. The MANUAL close-read (6x upscaled wall crops) is the gate per Discipline #4 and the method caveat, and it CONFIRMS the built arcade/storey/windows the probe under-counts — see report sections 2-3. The single objective signal that DID move correctly: zone1 went 0->1 (a balustrade/arcade rhythm now registers where iter3 read flat), corroborating the manual read that zone1 gained a real built gallery+balustrade.
our_iter4_summary.edge_density_note: edge densities remain HIGH and similar to iter3 — busyness is unchanged; the architecture build replaced clutter-edges with structure-edges at similar density, exactly why edge-density is the WRONG instrument and the manual coherence read is the gate.
